Graph Panel Module Server

Source: R/ro_shiny_graph_panel.R
ro_shiny_graph_panel_server.Rd

Server logic for the graph panel module. Handles rendering of the chart, toggling and displaying the table, and downloading data.

Usage

ro_shiny_graph_panel_server(
  id,
  plot_render_fun,
  plot_data_fun,
  data,
  caption,
  sorting = FALSE,
  pagelength = 10
)

Arguments

id

Character. Module namespace ID.

plot_render_fun

Function. A Shiny render function (plotly::renderPlotly, highcharter::renderHighchart, etc.).

plot_data_fun

Function. A function returning the data or plot object for the chart.

data

Data frame or tibble. The data to be shown in the table and available for download.

caption

Character. Caption/title for the data table.

sorting

Logical. Should the table allow column sorting? Default is FALSE. When used, apply the same in ro_shiny_graph_panel_ui.

pagelength

Integer. Number of rows per page in the data table. Default is 10.

Value

None. Sets up the server logic for the graph panel module.

See also

ro_shiny_graph_panel_ui, ro_shiny_graph_mod_server, ro_show_table_server, ro_shiny_download_server, ro_icon_download, ro_shiny_dt_ui, ro_shiny_dt_server

Other plotly: ro_shiny_graph_mod_server(), ro_shiny_graph_mod_ui(), ro_shiny_graph_panel_ui()

Other echarts: ro_shiny_graph_mod_server()

Other DT: ro_create_custom_button(), ro_icon_download(), ro_icon_table(), ro_shiny_download_server(), ro_shiny_download_ui(), ro_shiny_dt_responsive(), ro_shiny_dt_server(), ro_shiny_dt_ui(), ro_shiny_graph_panel_ui(), ro_shiny_screenreader(), ro_show_table_server(), ro_show_table_ui()

Examples

# In your Shiny server:
if (interactive()) {
  ro_shiny_graph_panel_server(
  id = "main",
  plot_render_fun = plotly::renderPlotly,
  plot_data_fun = function() plotly_obj,
  data = my_data,
  caption = "Aantal gevallen per groep",
  sorting = TRUE,
  pagelength = 20
  )
}
